h1: Custom Yoga Pants & Shorts for Bulk Orders
metaTitle: Custom Yoga Pants & Shorts | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom yoga pants and shorts in bulk for your studio or event. Perfect for comfort and branding. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Yoga-specific pants and shorts are designed with stretch, moisture-wicking fabric, and flat seams to support movement during practice. For studios, retreats, or corporate wellness programs, imprinting these with your logo turns activewear into a comfortable uniform. Choose from high-waisted leggings, capris, or shorts in performance blends that hold up to repeated washing. Screen printing or embroidery works well on the leg or waistband.
heroAltText: Custom yoga pants and shorts in assorted colors with logo imprint, ideal for studio branding and bulk orders.
